views.rationale: Revenues for the six months ended June 30, 2020 decreased by $8,706 million versus 2019
Declared quarterly cash dividend of $0.18 per share in July 2020
Second‑quarter 2020 sales fell to $9.997 billion, a 31% decline from $14.432 billion a year earlier
Revenues fell 2% YoY to $38.3 billion, with Google segment down 2% and Other Bets down 9%
Sovereign credit exposure rose to 34% of securities financing transactions, up from 28% a year earlier
Worldwide sales declined 3.8% to $39.0 billion in the first six months of 2020
Microsoft's revenue growth is expected to continue, driven by its cloud computing business.
NEE's revenue from contracts with customers is expected to continue growing, driven by its investments in renewable energy.
